newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia freezes Bre-X activities in country.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia freezes Bre-X activities in country.

text.p: Indonesian Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana said on Tuesday that the government has temporarily frozen all activities of Bre-X Minerals Ltd and its subsidiaries in the country.

He said at a news conference the government would also investigate the discrepancies in the estimates of gold in the Busang field between Bre-X and Canadian mining consultant Strathcona Mineral Services Ltd.
Sudjana also said the government had temporarily frozen two agreements in principle given to Bre-X in 1995 over the Busang property.
The two Bre-X subsidiaries affected by Sudjana's order include Bresea Resources Ltd and Bro-X Minerals Ltd, which signed contracts of work for two mining projects in Indonesia last month.
Strathcona said in a report released in Toronto on Sunday that the Busang property -- touted by Bre-X as the gold find of the century -- was unlikely to have a gold deposit worth mining.
